host_contract: Linux x86_64/glibc >=2.28; system Git >=2.39 and Python >=3.10. Pinned Node/npm bootstrapped by runtime/setup.py; exact base binaries recorded in manifest.

personal_binding_design.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
personal_binding_design.capability: native Vercel CLI plus REST (preferred CLI-capable design)
personal_binding_design.task_code_exposure: Raw token is readable by approved task processes/code; requires explicit binding approval.
personal_binding_design.argv_policy: Use VERCEL_TOKEN; never pass a token through --token or other command arguments.
personal_binding_design.acceptance: Test the pinned native CLI identity/target contract separately from REST and from write/deployment gates.

notes: Names and design only; no credentials, private targets or live configuration applied here. Activation explicitly selects factory-token by default. Project continuity belongs to the selected app repository; no central context repository is used. The host must support the required network execution grant; an allowlisted domain alone is insufficient.

binding_alternatives.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
binding_alternatives.capability: REST-only alternative; does not establish native CLI compatibility
binding_alternatives.selection: Choose one reviewed transport for this key; do not configure competing bindings. Changing raw-token exposure requires explicit approval.
binding_alternatives.observation: 2026-10-20: Vercel 64.5.0 REST identity/team reads worked while the native CLI rejected the network-secret placeholder before HTTP.
